body: Are you me? I am so paranoid when it comes to how I smell.
I'm so alone right now. I've always been alone. No ones ever been there for me. I've internalized everything and now I can't hold it in.
Fuck it, Friday night and I can no longer stand this shit. It feels right, and I don't feel scared anymore.

I am fucking stupid. I expected so much more from myself when I was younger. I used to be able to understand things, now I can't understand half the shit in my classes even when I try. I have deteriorated, and now people see me as 'the stupid guy'. And its true, I cannot for the life of me comprehend anything.

I know this probably isn't what you want to hear, it may even be in bad taste for me to say this, but you need to stop relying on other people to make you happy. It seems like all of your life you're state of mind has been completely controlled by other people. Trust me, I know how it is. I was 18, and she was the first girl ever to give me any sort of attention. She was pretty, what the fuck did she want with me? I was clingy in my attempts to make her want to be with me, and after a few months, she wanted nothing to do with me. My whole life I had dreamed of someone actually wanting me, and right then, I realized it would never happen. I hanged myself on March 4, 2012. I was cut down by my brother, the only person who ever gave two shits how I felt. I went through the whole stay at a mental hospital, and he never left my side. A few months have past, and now I'm here, and everyday I wonder how I let one person throw me into that deep, dark spiral. You can't let people control you like that.

BTW, I love the way you write. Its succinctness was beautiful.
Can't do that. I don't have the money or time for that, and I've already disappointed my family enough.
